text:
```yaml
name: Merge Workflow

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  merge-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Check if PR was merged
        id: check_merge_status
        run: echo "::set-output name=pr_merged::$(if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "pull_request" ] && [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" != "" ]; then jq '.pull_request.merged' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH; fi)"

      - name: Merge PR if successful
        if: steps.check_merge_status.outputs.pr_merged == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git checkout main
          git pull origin main
          git merge ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
          git push origin main
```
